content.value_statement: Teams need consistent client and server authentication patterns in Next.js. This skill shows Better Auth sign-in, sign-out, session checks, and AuthBar usage.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the client authentication export in lib/auth-client.ts.
Identifies the server authentication export in lib/auth.ts.
Shows email sign-in, Google social sign-in, and sign-out with authClient.
Shows server session checks using auth.api.getSession and Next.js headers.
Points to the AuthBar component and its session endpoint behavior.
limitations: Does not include full Better Auth installation steps.
Assumes a Next.js project with the documented auth file paths.
Does not cover role-based access control or permissions.
Does not document database adapter or provider setup.

output_examples.input: Ask for client sign-in guidance in a Next.js component.
output_examples.output: Explains to import authClient from lib/auth-client.ts, use email sign-in with email and password, and support Google social sign-in.

output_examples.input: Ask how to protect an API route or Server Action.
output_examples.output: Recommends reading headers, checking the session with auth.api.getSession, and returning Unauthorized when no session exists.

output_examples.input: Ask where the login UI is documented.
output_examples.output: Points to textbook/src/components/AuthBar/index.tsx and describes its avatar, login button, and session fetch behavior.

best_practices: Use authClient only in Client Components for sign-in and session UI.
Check auth.api.getSession before running protected server logic.
Keep authentication imports aligned with lib/auth-client.ts and lib/auth.ts.
anti_patterns: Do not copy client-only auth calls into server actions.
Do not assume a session exists before protected route work.
Do not change AuthBar behavior without checking the session endpoint.

faq.question: What authentication library does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses Better Auth for client and server authentication patterns.

faq.question: Which client export should I use?
faq.answer: Use authClient from lib/auth-client.ts for client-side sign-in, sign-out, and session UI.

faq.question: Which server export should I use?
faq.answer: Use auth from lib/auth.ts for server-side session checks.

faq.question: Does it cover social login?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows Google social sign-in with a callback URL.

faq.question: Does it protect API routes?
faq.answer: It shows checking the session and returning Unauthorized when no session exists.

faq.question: Does it include complete provider setup?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on usage patterns after Better Auth is already configured.
